chapter: Piano craft and the New York school
title: Tatum's nickelodeon imitation and "Tiger Rag"
summary: He imitated an out-of-tune nickelodeon and played "Tiger Rag," but could not play orchestral piano with a rhythm section.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Oh, yeah-yeah. Now, one of his favorite...I wouldn't say his favorite... But he would make a nickelodeon piano that's out of tune that when you put your...say when you put your nickel in... Then sometimes they would miss and all that, the irregularity of the whole roll. He used to do that very comically.
Oh... I tried doing that when I was playing a single!
Did he imitate Fats, too, on (?)?

Oh yeah, he could imitate Fats. But he was the first one I heard play "Tiger Rag." And due to his fierce technique that he had, it came across very well. But when he'd start striding, he had to come down in volume so you could hear it. He had it all fixed. He had a very... his own arrangement of "Tiger Rag."
But it wasn't orchestral piano. He sat in with the bands a couple of times, and it was difficult for him to
play with a rhythm section, see. Because he had so much, you know...so much piano...
